summary: As San Francisco Supervisor, Chan voted for the 8-3 Gaza ceasefire resolution in January 2024, an early step she later expanded: she called the war a genocide, pledged to end all US military aid, fund no Iron Dome, back a total arms embargo, and co-sponsor the Block the Bombs Act. She holds a standing pledge to refuse AIPAC money and was endorsed by Track AIPAC and CAIR Action, with an Ally rating from Vote for Peace.
